Sahyadri Care Hospital Pvt. Ltd.
Survey No. 12, Karve Road, Kothrud, Pune 411038
DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Patient: Mr. Rahul Sharma    Age/Sex: 42/M    Hospital ID: 2026-088123
Consultant: Dr. A. K. Mehta (Medicine)
Date of Admission: 12th September, 2026
Date of Discharge: 15th September, 2026
Diagnosis: Dengue fever (NS1 positive) with thrombocytopenia
Course in hospital: Managed with IV fluids and paracetamol. Platelet count monitored daily; lowest 48,000/cumm, recovered to 1,10,000/cumm.
Condition at discharge: Stable, afebrile, taking oral diet.
Advice on discharge: Continue medicines as prescribed. Plenty of oral fluids. Avoid heavy work for 2 weeks.
Follow-up: OPD after 7 days with reports.
